description: React component for rendering a detailed test report view, including filtering, navigation, and different display modes (file view, speedboard, test case). It manages state, handles keyboard navigation, and dynamically loads test case details.

classes.name: TestModelSummary
classes.description: Type defining the structure of the test model, including files and tests summaries.

classes.name: TestCaseViewLoader
classes.description: React component for asynchronously loading and displaying a specific test case based on testId.

methods.name: computeStats
methods.description: Calculates total tests and duration from a list of file summaries filtered by a criteria.

methods.name: createFilesModel
methods.description: Creates a model of files and tests from report data filtered by criteria.

methods.name: createMergedFilesModel
methods.description: Creates a merged view of test files grouped by describe blocks, filtered by criteria.

methods.name: createSpeedboardFilesModel
methods.description: Creates a model focusing on tests sorted by duration for speed analysis.
